thread:
nina: Quick sync — planning a coordinated bump next Thu. Targets: api v1.12.0, runtime v0.9.4, console v0.7.1, sdk-js v2.3.0. Please confirm changelog entries, any migration notes, and whether any repo needs a later cutoff.
kevin: ack. I’ll open runtime PR today. runtime has a kernel-selector tweak that could be a patch not minor; I’ll mark it in the PR. Link when ready.
taylor: console will need a tiny copy change for the new api fields. I can land a console PR but need api tag first.
sam: sdk-js: looks like one exported helper was renamed in platform; that’s a breaking change for consumers. Can we avoid breaking? If not, I need to prepare migration notes and update the SDK tests.
nina: good call. If sdk-js has breaking, let's keep it v3.0.0 instead — but prefer to avoid if possible. Kevin — can runtime avoid renaming the helper?
kevin: I can add a compatibility shim for one release to keep sdk-js minor. That buys time.
jamal: heads up — release pipeline has a branch sweep on Wed 23:00 UTC. Any PRs after that may miss the primary tag window. We should aim to have all PRs merged by Wed 22:00 so CI + canary run.
release-bot: [automated] Release window reminder: branch sweep scheduled 2024-11-13T23:00:00Z. Ensure changelogs are present and prs are labeled `release/ready`.
taylor: thanks @jamal — targeting Wed 20:00 for console to leave buffer.
sam: i’ll try for Wed 21:30 with migration notes in the PR body. If we can get the shim, I’ll keep sdk-js as 2.3.0.
nina: proposed checklist (paste into PRs):
```
- bump VERSION in repo
- add CHANGELOG entry under "Unreleased"
- add migration notes if applicable
- label PR `release/ready`
- confirm CI green + canary smoke
```
kevin: adding: runtime should include a `compat-shim` toggle with a TODO comment to remove in next major.
jamal: also confirm release notes in repo `docs/releases/` — CI checks that path for generated notes. Missing file will block cut.
taylor: noted. I’ll add an item to console PR template.
nina: ok team — summary of owners: runtime: kevin (PR today), api: nina (will tag after runtime PR), console: taylor (PR Weds), sdk-js: sam (PR Weds, depends on shim). Aim: merged by Wed 22:00 UTC. If anything slips, call it out here so we can move to a staggered rollout. :thumbsup:
kevin: sounds good. I’ll post runtime PR link in this thread when ready.
sam: thanks — will prepare migration section and tests.
release-bot: [automated] Noted assignees: runtime=kevin, api=nina, console=taylor, sdk-js=sam. Good luck! :party_parrot:
